truth_claims.note: conf=0.92; Urban fantasy/mystery anthology edited by George R. R. Martin and Gardner Dozois, published by Ace Books on October 4, 2011 (ISBN 0441020747). It is a standalone, unnumbered anthology — not part of a numbered series. It belongs only to the loose, unnumbered set of Martin/Dozois co-edited anthologies (Warriors, Songs of Love and Death, Dangerous Women, Rogues, Old Mars, Old Venus), which no source numbers as a sequence. Individual stories inside belong to authors' own series (e.g., Sookie Stackhouse universe, Nightside, Lord John Grey), but the book itself does not.

truth_claims.note: conf=0.93; Verified: an urban-fantasy/mystery anthology edited by George R. R. Martin and Gardner Dozois, published by Ace Books on October 4, 2011 (hardcover, ISBN 0441020747). Corrected the empty author field — the editors are the credited "authors" (contents are by Charlaine Harris, Patricia Briggs, Diana Gabaldon, Joe R. Lansdale, Simon R. Green, Steven Saylor, etc.). Series stays null: it is a standalone anthology. It is often grouped informally with other Martin/Dozois themed anthologies (Warriors, Songs of the Dying Earth, Dangerous Women, Rogues, Old Mars, Old Venus), but that is a loose editorial grouping, not a numbered published series, and no publisher or bibliographic source (Wikipedia, Penguin Random House, ISFDB listings) assigns it a series position. Individual stories belong to other authors' series (Sookie Stackhouse universe, Lord John Grey, Kitty Norville), but the book itself does not.
